entries.title: Add and rename a greeting helper in services/api
entries.brief: Add a small greeting helper, call it from main, then rename it to a clearer name.
entries.body: In services/api/main.go, add a new exported helper function in that same package that builds and returns a short greeting string (e.g. given a name, returns a greeting message). Update main() to call this new helper so it is actually used (printing the result is fine). Once that is in place, rename the helper to a more descriptive name that better reflects what it does. Keep the change minimal and scoped to services/api -- no new files or packages needed beyond what main.go already has, unless a bundled test file is appropriate for the new helper.

entries.title: Rename FormatGreeting to ComposeGreeting in services/api
entries.brief: Pure rename of an existing exported helper to a clearer name
entries.body: The exported helper `FormatGreeting` in `services/api/main.go` has a name that under-describes what it does — it composes the whole greeting sentence, not merely formats one. Rename the existing exported function `FormatGreeting` to `ComposeGreeting`, updating its call site in `main()` and every reference in its existing table-driven test. This is a PURE RENAME task: no new behavior, no new symbols beyond the renamed one, no signature change. Preserve git history with surgical edits (identifier retargeting only).

entries.title: Add a farewell path alongside ComposeGreeting in services/api
entries.brief: Extract a defaultName helper, add ComposeFarewell, and cover it with a table-driven test.
entries.body:
`services/api/main.go` currently exposes `ComposeGreeting(name string) string`, which returns `Hello, <name>!` and defaults an empty name to `world`.

Add a parallel farewell path, in three independently-committable steps, each of which must compile and pass `go test ./...` on its own:

1. Add a new unexported helper `defaultName(name string) string` in `services/api/main.go` that returns `world` when `name` is empty and `name` otherwise, and change `ComposeGreeting` to call it instead of inlining the empty check.
2. Add a new exported `ComposeFarewell(name string) string` in `services/api/main.go` that returns `Goodbye, <name>!` and uses the same `defaultName` helper.
3. Extend `services/api/main_test.go` with a table-driven `TestComposeFarewell` covering the same three cases the existing `TestComposeGreeting` covers, and update `main()` to print both the greeting and the farewell.

No other files change. No new packages, no new files beyond what already exists. Keep every step compiling and independently committable.

entries.title: Add a ComposeGreeting helper with default-name handling in services/api
entries.brief: Extend the FormatGreeting helper in services/api with default-name handling and a unit test.
entries.body:
## Background

services/api currently exposes a greeting helper used by main. We want callers to be able to pass an empty name and still get a friendly greeting.

## What to do

- Extend the FormatGreeting helper in services/api so an empty name falls back to a default name ("friend").
- Keep the exported surface small: one exported function returning a greeting string.
- Add a table-driven unit test covering the empty-name fallback and an ordinary name.

## Acceptance

- go build ./... and go test ./... pass in the worktree.
- The helper is called from main.go so the package has a real consumer.

entries.title: services/api prints a greeting through a Greeting helper
entries.brief: Add go.mod for services/api and a Greeting helper that main prints
entries.body:
## Wanted

- `services/api` gets its own `go.mod` (module `github.com/Knatte18/lym-test/services/api`, go 1.22) so it builds alone.
- A function `Greeting(name string) string` in `services/api/greeting.go` returns `Hello, <name>!`, and `Hello, world!` for an empty or all-whitespace name.
- `main` prints `Greeting("")` to stdout.
- `services/api/greeting_test.go` covers the named, empty and whitespace cases in one table test.
